jobs.description:
A career within Deals Capital Projects and Infrastructure will provide you the opportunity to deliver lead financial and strategic advisory services to our clients on infrastructure projects. Our work encompasses buy\-side and sell\-side M\&A advisory as well as leading capital financing transactions. We’re a part of helping some of the world’s leading companies and governments develop, build, finance, buy and sell infrastructure assets across the transportation, power and utilities, energy, mining, telecom and municipal infrastructure sectors. As part of our team, you’ll leverage quantitative analytics including industry research and benchmarking, financial modelling and historical trends analysis to inform and compel key decision\-making regarding infrastructure assets and portfolios.**The Opportunity:**

* As a Director, you will have a senior team role in delivering on mandates and business development. The practice focuses on four closely\-related service offerings:
* **Strategic Advisory** – leveraging analytics to help clients make key strategic decisions such as entering a new market, evaluating a new infrastructure development opportunity or determining whether to acquire/sell/monetize an existing asset or portfolio
* **Transaction Advisory** – helping clients evaluate and execute M\&A, financing or partnership transactions (acquisitions, divestitures, capital raising, P3s, JVs, offtake and other contractual arrangements)
* **Procurement Advisory** – assisting clients in developing and evaluating options related to long\-term performance\-based contacts
* **Project Risk Advisory** – assisting clients understand and quantify the various risks and available mitigants associated with a large project or acquisition (commercial and financial due diligence)

* Continue to build and develop a high\-quality team – training and guiding junior staff through their analytics while quality controlling their work product and ensuring outputs are meaningful
* Position the team in the marketplace and develop/originate new business
* Work collaboratively with other competencies and lines of service as well as with other offices across Canada in business development and project execution

 **What you’ll bring:**

* Proven analytical and transaction skills
* Relevant experience in project finance, financial analysis, transaction structuring and strategic/investment decision\-making in the public and private infrastructure sectors
* Experience in capital raising on projects requiring large amounts of funds from sources including government bodies, financial institutions and development banks
* A history of project finance transactions with a demonstrated ability to close deals in at least three of the following sectors: transportation, power and utilities, energy, mining, telecom and municipal infrastructure
* Experience negotiating the terms of new financing structures, building financial models and performing detailed asset\-level commercial and financial due diligence
* Excellent leadership and project management skills demonstrated with experience managing individual and multidisciplinary teams on complex major projects from the beginning to the end of the transaction
* Strong communication and presentation skills demonstrated in working with senior stakeholders across financial institutions, government and the public and private sectors
* Ability to drive business development including through competitive proposals
* Experience with a Big 4 financial advisory firm is an asset


This position ensures continuity and upholds our standards of excellence following the departure of a valued team member.

jobs.title: Senior Director, AI Architecture
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**What is the opportunity?**
----------------------------

  

This leader sets one standard way to build, secure and run AI across RBC Technology \& Operations. They own the reference architecture for retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, model access and AI\-native software delivery (AI\-DLC). The role turns the 2030 T\&O ambitions, including AI\-native delivery and 30% of GenAI volume on open\-weight models, into patterns teams actually use.


Success means fewer bespoke stacks, faster delivery with maintainable code, and AI that Internal Audit, Model Risk and OSFI can trust.

**What will you do****?**
-------------------------

* **AI architecture standards as code.** Define the enterprise AI reference architecture and approved patterns. Encode them as harness skills, agent constitutions and automated fitness checks, so standards apply at generation time rather than at review.
* **Common RAG substrate.** Converge the many RAG solutions onto one shared platform: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking and evaluation. Retrieval must respect source entitlements by default. Set a retirement plan for duplicate stacks.
* **Agent sandboxing and security architecture.** Design the sandbox standard for every agentic workload: ephemeral environments, egress allow\-lists, short\-lived task\-scoped credentials and no standing production access. Own agent identity, tool access through a governed MCP gateway and registry, and defenses against prompt injection and poisoned tools.
* **AI\-DLC harness and quality gates.** Own the harness architecture from spec to release. Make quality gates deterministic and mandatory: tests and coverage, static analysis, complexity and duplication limits, dependency and license checks, security scanning and architecture fitness checks. Enforce separation of duties (the agent that writes a change cannot approve it), PR size limits and traceability from spec to deployment.
* **Skills and evaluation lifecycle.** Treat skills like code: owned, versioned, regression\-tested with evals and retired when stale. Re\-run evals before any model upgrade reaches teams.
* **Model gateway and inference architecture.** Route work across frontier and open\-weight models by cost, risk and jurisdiction. Build in token metering, caching and data\-classification rules so cost and residency are enforced by the platform.
* **Risk\-tiered control model.** Partner with Internal Audit, Model Risk and Cyber to define human\-oversight tiers, from human\-on\-the\-loop for low\-risk work to human\-in\-the\-loop for payments and core banking. Align with OSFI Guidelines E\-23 and B\-13\.
* **Design authority and innovation.** Chair AI architecture review, keep decision records and manage exceptions. Graduate proven lab work into the platform and evaluate emerging technology, such as agent protocols and new open\-weight models.

**What do you need to succeed?**
--------------------------------

* 15\+ years in architecture or engineering, including 5\+ years leading architects or engineers at enterprise scale.
* Hands\-on depth in LLM systems: RAG, agent frameworks, MCP, evaluation and inference serving on cloud and on\-premises GPUs.
* Security architecture for AI, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications, sandboxing and identity for non\-human actors.
* Strong DevSecOps and SDLC background; you have shipped quality gates engineers accepted rather than routed around.
* Experience in a regulated industry, ideally financial services under OSFI.
* Credibility with engineers: you still prototype and read code. Able to explain trade\-offs plainly to executives and audit.

 **What’s in it for you?**


We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

  

* A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
* Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
* Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
* Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high\-performing team
* A world\-class training program in financial services
* Flexible work/life balance options
* Opportunities to do challenging work

jobs.title: PLM/MES Business Transformation Director
jobs.description:
Building the space between proven and possible, MDA Space (TSX:MDA) is a trusted mission partner to the global space industry. A robotics, satellite systems and geointelligence pioneer with a 55\-year\+ story of world firsts and more than 450 missions, MDA Space is a global leader in communications satellites, Earth and space observation, and space exploration and infrastructure. The MDA Space team of more than 3,400 space experts in Canada, the US and the UK has the knowledge and know\-how to turn an audacious customer vision into an achievable mission – bringing to bear a one\-of\-a\-kind mix of experience, engineering excellence and wide\-eyed wonder that’s been in our DNA since day one. For those who dream big and push boundaries on the ground and in the stars to change the world for the better, we’ll take you there.


**The Role:**



The **PLM/MES Business Transformation Director** is accountable for leading complex, enterprise\-wide **PLM and MES transformation initiatives** across multiple business units. This role requires senior\-level experience delivering large\-scale implementations in highly complex environments, driving alignment across business, operations, engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT stakeholders. The role is responsible for translating strategic objectives into executable roadmaps, elevating processes and system capabilities to **industry best practices**, and ensuring disciplined execution, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.


**Key Accountabilities**


* Lead enterprise\-wide end\-to\-end PLM and MES implementation across functions, sites, and business units.
* Align business strategy with operational priorities and program objectives for scalable enterprise processes.
* Build and manage integrated roadmaps covering harmonization, solution design, deployment, change management, and capability enhancement.
* Own program governance: scope, milestones, risks, issues, budget, benefits, and executive reporting.
* Align complex, disparate requirements, decisions, and deployment priorities among business, manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT stakeholders.
* Guide cross\-functional teams, vendors, and experts in a matrix environment.
* Embed PLM and MES solutions into operations through adoption, governance, training, and continuous improvement.
* Translate business and regulatory needs into actionable implementation plans.
* Coordinate process design, configuration, data readiness, integration, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
* Ensure PLM/MES capabilities align with enterprise platforms and digital transformation.
* Drive standardization and best practices while balancing business realities.
* Define success metrics, KPIs, and readiness measures for transformation programs.
* Manage delivery risk, dependencies, escalation, and remediation.
* Present concise updates to Steering Committees and senior leadership.
* Focus on business outcomes, adoption, and sustained value post\-deployment.


**Stakeholder \& Change Leadership**


* Serve as a trusted transformation partner to senior leaders across business, operations, manufacturing, engineering, and technology functions
* Drive alignment across enterprise leaders with differing priorities, legacy processes, and business unit requirements to achieve common PLM and MES outcomes
* Lead business change activities to ensure stakeholder readiness, process adoption, and sustainable capability uplift across impacted teams
* Influence decision\-making, resolve cross\-functional conflicts, and drive timely executive escalation in a complex matrixed environment


**Required Expereince:**


* **15\+ years' experience** leading large, complex enterprise transformation and system implementation programs
* Demonstrated senior\-level experience delivering **PLM and MES implementations** in highly complex, multi\-business\-unit enterprise environments
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
* Program or Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent)
* Proven track record of managing multi\-workstream programs with significant organizational change, cross\-functional dependencies, and enterprise process alignment.
* Experience working in matrixed or federated operating models across multiple business units, functions, and implementation partners.
* Executive\-level communication experience, including Steering Committee engagement, sponsor management, and senior stakeholder alignment.
* Experience with process standardization, global template or multi\-site deployment approaches, and industry best practice adoption is an asset


**Leadership Capabilities:**


* Strong outcome‑orientation with a bias for action and accountability
* Ability to influence at senior levels without direct authority
* High tolerance for ambiguity and ability to structure complex problems
* Pragmatic, disciplined, and calm under pressure
* Trusted advisor mindset with strong judgment and professionalism


**Special Considerations:**



Successful candidates must obtain and hold security clearance at the Reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Controlled Goods Program (CGP), and be able to obtain higher clearances.

jobs.title: VP, Operations & Transformation
jobs.description:
**About Big Viking Games**


Founded in 2011, Big Viking Games is an independent Toronto\-based consumer entertainment company behind YoWorld and Fish World, two long\-running social games played by tens of millions of people over the years. Our business is built on loyal communities, recurring player engagement and a team with deep roots in web and live\-service technology.


Today, we are modernizing how the company operates to keep pace with a fast\-moving technology landscape. We are rethinking how our teams plan, execute and grow the business, and building an organization designed for the next decade of consumer digital products.

**About the Role**


As VP, Operations \& Transformation, you will lead the modernization of Big Viking Games and run the operations that power the business. You will report to the CEO, serve on the leadership team and work alongside our product, engineering and creative leaders to set direction and deliver results across functions. Your remit covers studio production, product operations, people operations, accounting and IT, and the systems that connect them.


Success in this seat calls for an AI\-native operator who builds with AI firsthand and leads the shift to a modernized operating model across the business. You bring a systems view of the organization, a strong command of operating leverage and capital efficiency, and the judgment to balance near\-term performance with long\-term value creation, while leading change through clear communication and strong stakeholder alignment.


We value in\-person collaboration, and this role works from our Toronto Harbourfront office at least 3 days a week.

**What You'll Do**


This is a hands\-on executive role at the center of the business, connecting strategy, operations and people across every function:

* **Lead the transformation agenda.** Define the roadmap for modernizing the company's operating model, and drive it from design through adoption across every function.
* **Run operations across the business.** Lead studio and product operations, people operations, accounting and IT, with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
* **Own the operating plan.** Partner with the CEO on the P\&L, set the annual operating plan and cost structure, and track performance against it.
* **Modernize processes and systems.** Bring in modern tools and practices, including AI, where they create the most value, and measure the impact they deliver.
* **Build the team and culture.** Shape the structure, roles and culture for the company's next chapter, and develop the leaders who will carry it forward.
* **Drive strategic initiatives.** Lead priorities that span teams, run the planning and review rhythm, and keep the leadership team aligned on what matters most.

  

**Requirements** **What You Bring**

* 15\+ years of experience, including 3\+ years leading a P\&L or operating budget.
* Experience in consumer software or digital services businesses, ideally with transactional or subscription revenue.
* You use and build with AI daily, have led its adoption across teams, and set a high bar for how effectively your organization puts it to work.

jobs.description:
Department  

  



Finance  

  



  

Reports to  

  



Chief Financial Officer  

  



  

Base salary  

  



$240,000 – $260,000  

  



  

Bonus  

  



Annual bonus opportunity  

  



  

**Overview**
------------

Our client is a fast\-growing developer, owner and operator of community solar, distributed generation and energy storage assets in the US. They are hiring a Senior Vice President to lead capital formation, structured finance, investment underwriting, capital allocation and financial planning.  

  



Reporting to the CFO, you will build and execute the financing strategies that fund the company's next stage of growth.  

  



**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Capital markets and capital formation**

* Develop and execute the capital markets strategy with the CFO, CEO and executive leadership team.
* Lead capital raising across project, portfolio, asset and corporate financing structures.
* Evaluate and execute financing options, including:
	+ Construction debt
	+ Term debt and back\-leverage facilities
	+ Tax equity and tax credit transfers
	+ Preferred equity and growth equity
	+ Corporate debt and revolving credit facilities
	+ Joint ventures and portfolio financings
	+ Structured capital solutions and asset\-level refinancing
	+ Other strategic financing arrangements
* Build financing strategies that balance cost of capital, liquidity, execution certainty, covenants, risk allocation and long\-term enterprise value.
* Lead negotiations with commercial banks, institutional investors, infrastructure funds, tax equity providers, private credit providers, investment banks, rating agencies and other capital partners.
* Run financing processes end to end: market engagement, term sheets, diligence, documentation, closing and post\-closing compliance.
* Maintain relationships with existing capital providers and open up new sources of institutional capital.
* Track capital markets conditions, interest rates, lender requirements, tax equity availability, investor appetite and renewable energy financing trends.
* Recommend when to finance, refinance, hold, sell, aggregate or otherwise monetise individual assets and portfolios.

### **Project and portfolio capitalisation strategy**

* Set up a disciplined process for deciding which projects and portfolios to prioritise for capitalisation.
* Assess projects on development maturity, interconnection status, permitting, site control, subscriber readiness, offtake, revenue certainty, construction needs, tax credit eligibility, financing availability and projected returns.
* Work with Development, Project Finance, EPC, Asset Management, Subscriber Management, Legal, Tax, Accounting and Operations to judge project readiness and financing risk.
* Build and maintain a prioritised capitalisation roadmap for the development pipeline and operating portfolio.
* Recommend the best timing, structure and grouping of projects for financing.
* Decide whether projects are financed individually, aggregated into portfolios, placed in warehouse facilities, contributed to joint ventures or funded with corporate capital.
* Weigh how to deploy limited capital across community solar, commercial and industrial solar, standalone storage and hybrid solar\-plus\-storage.
* Identify capital constraints, concentration risks, funding gaps and dependencies that could affect construction schedules or commercial operation dates.
* Recommend corrective actions or alternative structures when projects fall short of capitalisation requirements.
* Monitor capitalised projects against underwriting assumptions, financing milestones, budgets and expected returns.

### **Project underwriting and investment analysis**

* Lead financial underwriting for community solar, distributed generation, energy storage and related investments.
* Set consistent underwriting standards, investment criteria, risk classifications and minimum return thresholds.
* Evaluate project and portfolio economics, including:
	+ Development, construction, interconnection and operating costs
	+ Generation and production assumptions
	+ Subscriber acquisition and management costs
	+ PPA terms and community solar credit values
	+ Renewable energy incentives, Investment Tax Credits and adders
	+ Debt sizing and tax equity economics
	+ Merchant versus contracted revenue exposure
	+ Residual and terminal value
* Assess risks across development, interconnection, permitting, construction, supply chain, revenue, customer concentration, regulation, financing conditions and operating performance.
* Make sure investment recommendations combine quantitative analysis with a grounded view of execution risk.
* Own underwriting templates, approval thresholds, risk methodologies and investment review procedures.
* Compare actual project and portfolio performance with original underwriting, explain variances and recommend corrective action.
* Feed lessons from operating assets and completed financings back into underwriting standards.

### **Financial modelling and sensitivity analysis**

* Provide executive oversight of project, portfolio, financing and enterprise financial models.
* Personally review, modify and challenge complex models, rather than relying on outputs alone.
* Use models to test alternative capital structures, financing terms, project groupings, development schedules and operating assumptions.
* Run sensitivity, scenario and downside analysis on capital costs, interest rates, debt capacity, tax equity terms, tax credit eligibility, construction costs, production, subscriber performance, revenue rates, operating expenses, delays, refinancing and exit values.
* Evaluate IRR, NPV, ROIC, cash yield, debt\-service coverage, leverage and payback.
* Keep models accurate, transparent, auditable and aligned with approved corporate assumptions.
* Set model governance: version control, review standards, ownership and approval protocols.
* Turn complex analysis into concise conclu

jobs.title: Senior Transformation Director
jobs.description:
D2L is a cloud company that is modernizing education and building the Future of Work. The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift.



New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student\-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies.



D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L.



D2L has had a singular mission for 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally.



Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team \- yes, a real person looks at your resume! While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations.

  


**Job Summary:**



The Senior Transformation Director leads D2L's Artificial Intelligence Transformation Office (AITO) program, which exists to change how D2L works by helping every team turn AI into real outcomes — faster execution, better decisions, and less time spent on the mundane. The role builds the literacy, confidence, and capability for teams to use AI effectively and responsibly, moving pragmatically, keeping it simple, and making responsible use of AI the default.



The Senior Director owns D2L's AITO portfolio end to end and leads through influence — partnering with functional leaders across the business and technical teams to reimagine how core processes and emerging technology will transform D2L's approach to work.



The Senior Director is accountable for the operational results of each initiative, measured in cycle time, cost to serve, quality, decision speed, and capacity returned to higher\-value work. Process redesign and new technology are delivered as a single piece of work, since neither produces a result on its own. Functional teams lead the change in their own areas, supported by the method, patterns, and enablement this role provides, which keeps ownership and capability in the business after an initiative closes.


**How will I make an impact?**


*AI Evangelism, Literacy, and Enablement*


* Develop AI literacy and capability across functions through enablement programs, cohorts, playbooks, office hours, and reusable patterns.
* Make responsible use the default by building clear, simple guidance on appropriate use, data handling, and human oversight into everyday workflows
* Establish reusable, governed design patterns for AI agents and use controlled review\-and\-improvement cycles to deliver reliable business outcomes more quickly.
* Keep enablement and guidance current as internal tooling, platform capabilities, and the external AI landscape evolve.
* Ensure every AI\-enabled change carries the enablement, adoption, measurement, and support model needed to sustain it.


*Portfolio Ownership and Governance*


* Partner with various business unit leaders to uncover operational friction points, identify high\-impact AI use cases, and consolidate these into a unified AITO roadmap that drives operational change across the organization.
* Ensure work is measured by sustained business outcomes — revenue growth, profitability, increased output, time returned, cycle time, quality, decision speed, and real adoption — not only by activity or implementation milestones.
* Report portfolio health, adoption, and realized value to the AITO Steering Committee and senior leaders on a regular cadence.
* Conduct retrospectives and embed lessons learned into D2L's transformation methods, practices, and standards.
* Serve as the primary interface to the Senior Leadership team at D2L — bringing forward prioritization decisions, tradeoffs, capacity constraints, and risks, and carrying decisions back into the portfolio.


*Process and Technology Reimagination*


* Define the target technology footprint for each redesign, including where AI, automation, and integration are applied, what existing systems and services are extended, retired or consolidated.
* Identify opportunities to simplify work, reduce manual effort, improve execution quality, and increase operational effectiveness.
* Lead the redesign of business processes, workflows, roles, decision rights, and handoffs so future\-state ways of working are practical and grounded in a clear business outcome.
* Ensure future\-state processes include clear ownership, documentation, adoption needs, and transition plans for steady\-state ownership.
* Partner with Information Technology, Security, Legal, and Privacy to ensure that solutions are responsible, supportable, secure, and aligned with D2L standards


*Change, Adoption, and Sustained Use*


* Apply a people\-first change approach: involve affected teams in the design and give people the opportunity to forge how new ways of working take shape.
* Support leaders and teams as they adopt new processes, tools, roles, and ways of working, and intervene where adoption stalls.
* Use adoption feedback and lessons learned to improve future transformation work.

  


**What** **You'll** **Bring to the Role**


* 10\+ years of progressive experience leading, business operations, process improvement, organizational change, and enterprise transformation
* Hands\-on fluency with current AI tools, with enough technical depth to assess feasibility, effort, and risk credibly alongside technical partners.
* Strong understanding of process redesign, operating\-model change, adoption, and value re

LiftWerx is a specialized wind energy contractor which performs large corrective repairs, mainly using crane\-less technology. LiftWerx offers both specialized equipment and experienced personnel to perform corrective repairs on a wide variety of wind turbines. The majority of lifting services are performed using up\-tower crane technology, which avoids the high cost and disruption of utilizing large conventional cranes on the ground.

This role will play a central part in accelerating the deployment of artificial intelligence (AI) and automation capabilities across the organization to improve productivity, enhance decision\-making, reduce manual effort, and accelerate business performance. Joining as the organization actively rolls out its AI roadmap, governance framework, and enterprise AI platform, the leader will have a high degree of influence over how these evolve and will drive the adoption strategy that enables employees and leaders to effectively leverage emerging technologies while ensuring appropriate security, compliance, and risk controls.

jobs.description:

**Overview**
------------

Our client is a fast\-growing developer, owner and operator of community solar, distributed generation and energy storage assets in the US. They are hiring a Senior Vice President to lead capital formation, structured finance, investment underwriting, capital allocation and financial planning.  

  



Reporting to the CFO, you will build and execute the financing strategies that fund the company's next stage of growth.  

  



**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Capital markets and capital formation**

* Develop and execute the capital markets strategy with the CFO, CEO and executive leadership team.
* Lead capital raising across project, portfolio, asset and corporate financing structures.
* Evaluate and execute financing options, including:
	+ Construction debt
	+ Term debt and back\-leverage facilities
	+ Tax equity and tax credit transfers
	+ Preferred equity and growth equity
	+ Corporate debt and revolving credit facilities
	+ Joint ventures and portfolio financings
	+ Structured capital solutions and asset\-level refinancing
	+ Other strategic financing arrangements
* Build financing strategies that balance cost of capital, liquidity, execution certainty, covenants, risk allocation and long\-term enterprise value.
* Lead negotiations with commercial banks, institutional investors, infrastructure funds, tax equity providers, private credit providers, investment banks, rating agencies and other capital partners.
* Run financing processes end to end: market engagement, term sheets, diligence, documentation, closing and post\-closing compliance.
* Maintain relationships with existing capital providers and open up new sources of institutional capital.
* Track capital markets conditions, interest rates, lender requirements, tax equity availability, investor appetite and renewable energy financing trends.
* Recommend when to finance, refinance, hold, sell, aggregate or otherwise monetise individual assets and portfolios.

### **Project and portfolio capitalisation strategy**

* Set up a disciplined process for deciding which projects and portfolios to prioritise for capitalisation.
* Assess projects on development maturity, interconnection status, permitting, site control, subscriber readiness, offtake, revenue certainty, construction needs, tax credit eligibility, financing availability and projected returns.
* Work with Development, Project Finance, EPC, Asset Management, Subscriber Management, Legal, Tax, Accounting and Operations to judge project readiness and financing risk.
* Build and maintain a prioritised capitalisation roadmap for the development pipeline and operating portfolio.
* Recommend the best timing, structure and grouping of projects for financing.
* Decide whether projects are financed individually, aggregated into portfolios, placed in warehouse facilities, contributed to joint ventures or funded with corporate capital.
* Weigh how to deploy limited capital across community solar, commercial and industrial solar, standalone storage and hybrid solar\-plus\-storage.
* Identify capital constraints, concentration risks, funding gaps and dependencies that could affect construction schedules or commercial operation dates.
* Recommend corrective actions or alternative structures when projects fall short of capitalisation requirements.
* Monitor capitalised projects against underwriting assumptions, financing milestones, budgets and expected returns.

### **Project underwriting and investment analysis**

* Lead financial underwriting for community solar, distributed generation, energy storage and related investments.
* Set consistent underwriting standards, investment criteria, risk classifications and minimum return thresholds.
* Evaluate project and portfolio economics, including:
	+ Development, construction, interconnection and operating costs
	+ Generation and production assumptions
	+ Subscriber acquisition and management costs
	+ PPA terms and community solar credit values
	+ Renewable energy incentives, Investment Tax Credits and adders
	+ Debt sizing and tax equity economics
	+ Merchant versus contracted revenue exposure
	+ Residual and terminal value
* Assess risks across development, interconnection, permitting, construction, supply chain, revenue, customer concentration, regulation, financing conditions and operating performance.
* Make sure investment recommendations combine quantitative analysis with a grounded view of execution risk.
* Own underwriting templates, approval thresholds, risk methodologies and investment review procedures.
* Compare actual project and portfolio performance with original underwriting, explain variances and recommend corrective action.
* Feed lessons from operating assets and completed financings back into underwriting standards.

### **Financial modelling and sensitivity analysis**

* Provide executive oversight of project, portfolio, financing and enterprise financial models.
* Personally review, modify and challenge complex models, rather than relying on outputs alone.
* Use models to test alternative capital structures, financing terms, project groupings, development schedules and operating assumptions.
* Run sensitivity, scenario and downside analysis on capital costs, interest rates, debt capacity, tax equity terms, tax credit eligibility, construction costs, production, subscriber performance, revenue rates, operating expenses, delays, refinancing and exit values.
* Evaluate IRR, NPV, ROIC, cash yield, debt\-service coverage, leverage and payback.
* Keep models accurate, transparent, auditable and aligned with approved corporate assumptions.
* Set model governance: version control, review standards, ownership and approval protocols.

jobs.title: Director, Digital Safety
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a role where you can define the future of digital safety in a complex, mission\-critical environment? Can you see yourself leading enterprise\-wide cybersecurity programs while establishing the standards, controls, and governance frameworks that protect critical digital systems and information assets? If you answered yes, this may be the job for you. **Apply today,** as our Chalk River location is looking for a **Director, Digital Safety** to lead the development and implementation of CNL's Digital Safety Framework.

**What you will be doing!**

* Digital Safety Framework \& Standards Authority
	+ Defining, maintaining, and evolving the enterprise Digital Safety Framework, incorporating nuclear safety principles such as defence\-in\-depth, graded approach, and continuous improvement.
	+ Establishing and governing mandatory, non\-negotiable digital safety control requirements applicable to:
		- Information systems
		- Operational technologies
		- Nuclear\-related digital assets
		- Identity and access managemen
		- Data protection and asset lifecycle management
	+ Translating external standards (CSA N290\.7, ISO 27001, NIST, IAEA) into a cohesive, internally consistent Digital Safety Framework.
	+ Defining the baseline conditions required for safe digital operations, ensuring clarity in expectations across all business and operational areas.
* Program Implementation
	+ Embedding Digital Safety requirements into all business processes, projects, and operational activities to obtain compliance with defined safety standards.
	+ Developing and delivering enterprise\-wide programs to build digital safety awareness, competency, and behavioural accountability.
	+ Driving the integration of human factors and behavioural science into digital safety practices, reinforcing safe decision\-making and risk\-awareness across the workforce.
	+ Promoting and enforcing understanding so that all employees and contractors understand their role in maintaining digital safety and operate within defined safety expectations.
* Control Oversight and Operational Assurance
	+ Exercising authority to mandate that all digital systems and activities comply with established Digital Safety requirements.
	+ Conducting assessments, audits, and monitoring to validate adherence to safety standards and identifying gaps or vulnerabilities.
	+ Leading incident response readiness and coordinating response activities, ensuring compliance with defined safety and regulatory requirements.
	+ Maintaining enterprise visibility of digital assets and establish appropriate classification, protection, and lifecycle management.
* Governance, Compliance, and External Alignment
	+ Overseeing and confirming alignment with regulatory requirements and maintain readiness for audits and inspections.
	+ Building and maintaining relationships with regulatory bodies, industry organizations, and external experts.
	+ Monitoring emerging threats, technologies, and regulatory changes, incorporating them into the Digital Safety Framework as appropriate.
* Leadership and Organizational Capability
	+ Leading and developing a high\-performing team of digital safety professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, excellence, and continuous improvement.
	+ Developing workforce capability plans to build and sustain the skills required to execute Digital Safety objectives.
	+ Managing budgets, resources, and priorities to deliver on strategic Digital Safety objectives.

Other duties as assigned by your manager.  
* 

**What we are looking for:**

* **Education**
	+ Bachelor's or Master's degree in cyber Security, Information Systems, Business Administration or related field, or equivalent work experience.
	+ Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, ITIL) are highly desirable.
* **Experience**
	+ 10\+ years of experience in cyber security, with specific expertise in nuclear or critical infrastructure protection preferred.
	+ 10\+ years in progressive leadership roles.
	+ Demonstrated experience establishing and governing enterprise security or control frameworks.
	+ Experience implementing and interpreting industry and regulatory standards (e.g., CSA N290\.7, ISO 27001, NIST).
	+ Proven ability to lead large\-scale organizational transformation and embed control disciplines in complex environments.
	+ Experience in operational technology (OT), industrial control systems (ICS), or SCADA environments strongly preferred.
	+ Experience in managing budgets, strategic planning, and resource allocation.
* **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
	+ Ability to define and communicate a clear Digital Safety vision and framework aligned to nuclear safety principles.
	+ Strong understanding of defence\-in\-depth, risk\-based control models, and safety\-critical system governance.
	+ Exceptional decision\-making and judgement in high\-risk and complex environments.
	+ Ability to establish authority and enforce standards in environments with competing priorities.
	+ Strong influencing and negotiation skills, particularly in cross\-functional and non\-hierarchical contexts.
	+ Deep understanding of current and emerging cyber threats and mitigation strategies.
	+ Ability to translate technical controls into clear, actionable safety requirements.
	+ Strong leadership and people development capabilities.
	+ Ability to drive behavioural and cultural change across a diverse workforce.
	+ Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage both technical and executive audiences.
	+ Strong knowledge of:  
	
	o CSA N290\.7 (Nuclear Cyber Security)  
	
	o ISO 27001  
	
	o NIST Cybersecurity Framework  
	
	o IAEA guidance and nuclear regulatory expectations
	+ Familiarity with OT/ICS environments and digital instrumentation \& control systems.
	+ Understanding of how nuclear safety principles apply to digital systems.
	+ Experience applying structured change management approaches (i.e., ADKAR).
* **Security Clearance Eligibility Required**
	+ Level 3 S
